title: Cloud Security: provisioning limits
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for provisioning limits.

## Basis

Maximum provisioned resource count: Maximum provisioned resource count in one holding; integer.

Monthly accepted amendment limit: Maximum accepted capacity amendments per holding in a UTC calendar month; integer.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Maximum provisioned resource count | Monthly accepted amendment limit |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 64 | 12 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 64 | 12 |

## Tier comparison

The listed provisioning limits bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
